name: Mooncap Mushroom
description: A rare mushroom that only grows in the light of a full moon. Said to have mild sedative properties and a faintly luminescent quality.

name: Grave Mint
description: A hardy mint that grows in graveyards and other places touched by death. It has a refreshing aroma and a bitter, earthy flavor.

name: Black Ichor
description: A viscous, tar-like substance that seeps from the wounds of certain cursed creatures. It is highly toxic and has a corrupting influence on those who handle it.

name: Lavender Ash
description: A fine ash made from burned lavender flowers. It has a soothing scent and is often used in calming rituals and sleep aids.

name: Obsidian Resin
description: A glossy, pitch-dark resin that hardens in moonless air. Brewers prize it for binding volatile mixtures into stable tinctures.

name: Amber Nightshade
description: A poisonous nightshade blossom sealed in honey-colored sap. Its warm scent lingers in the mind and draws out vivid nocturnal reveries.

name: Silver Thorn Bloom
description: A pale flower with needle-fine petals that glint like silver in dusk light. Distillers value it for sharp clarity and wakeful focus.

name: Moonwhisper Orchid
description: A dusk-bloom orchid whose petals shimmer pale blue under moonlight. Its fragrance soothes the mind while coaxing vivid dreams.

name: Raven Ash Peony
description: A smoke-dark peony harvested from old funeral grounds. When crushed, it releases a soft gray ash that steadies trembling hands.

name: Iron Lullaby Root
description: A knotted root with a hard metallic skin and a strangely comforting scent. Brewers grate it into tonics meant to quiet panic and blunt pain.

name: Mercury Vision Resin
description: A quicksilver resin sealed in a glassy skin. It glows faintly in darkness and is used to sharpen sight, though it can unsettle the body.

name: Hallowed Balm Leaf
description: A blessed balm leaf that carries the faint scent of incense and rain. It is dried for restorative salves and rites of protection.
